verdict.rationale: Weave's marketing page says its alerts can "trigger webhook automations", so outbound webhooks appear to be a first-party capability triggered by signals. The evidence is a single repeated marketing line with no technical documentation. missing for 10: docs on registering webhook endpoints, the list of subscribable event types, payload schema and signing, retry/delivery semantics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Alerts route what matters through Slack notifications and trigger webhook automations, turning every production insight into a fast iteration.
